name: trueCABLE
old_description: From bulk Ethernet and fiber cable to terminations and tools, trueCABLE delivers professional-grade products designed for seamless installs and rock-solid performance. Every item is tested to exceed industry standards — so your network runs faster, longer, and more reliably.
about:
trueCABLE is based in Kansas City, Missouri. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It operates as a brand supplying Ethernet and fiber optic connectivity products.

The company offers a range of networking infrastructure components, including bulk Ethernet cable (Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6A), fiber patch cables, RJ45 connectors, keystone jacks, patch panels, and installation tools such as crimpers, strippers, and punch-down tools. Products are built with solid bare-copper conductors and are tested to meet UL, ANSI/TIA, and U.S. safety standards. Part numbers such as 6ASCMRBLU_1Krl identify specific cable configurations.

Customers include data centers, commercial offices, industrial facilities, and residential installers. The company's patch panels are marketed for data centers, offices, and industrial settings, while its bulk cable targets both home networks and commercial infrastructure. Coaxial cable is offered for low-voltage and satellite installations.

trueCABLE differentiates itself with same-day shipping on orders placed by 3 p.m. CT, a lifetime "Forever Warranty" on tools and cable, and a 30-day money-back guarantee. It emphasizes that its cable, connectors, and tools are validated as a complete system, and it provides educational resources through its Cable Academy.
